text: During execution, `InitDefaultVersionFlag` does nothing when `Command.Version` is empty or a `version` flag already exists. Otherwise it creates boolean `--version`, adds `-v` only if that shorthand is free, and marks the flag with `FlagSetByCobraAnnotation` (`command.go:1200-1225`). Completion logic recognizes a changed Cobra-created version flag via that annotation (`completions.go:522-533`).
